rules.logic: XQL(CSPM-003 Wildcard-Trust or Unrestricted PassRole IAM Posture Finding) AND ( XQL(CSPM-003 Anonymous or Cross-Account AssumeRole on Exposed Role) OR XQL(CSPM-003 IMDS Role-Credential Retrieval from Compromised Workload) ) AND XQL(CSPM-003 PassRole and AttachRolePolicy Granting AdministratorAccess) AND XQL(CSPM-003 KMS Decrypt and Bulk S3 GetObject from Newly-Privileged Session) — fuses the CSPM wildcard-trust/unrestricted-PassRole posture finding (Signal A) with the runtime AssumeRole plus IMDS credential retrieval plus AttachRolePolicy AdministratorAccess privilege-escalation chain (Signal B) and the KMS-Decrypt plus bulk S3 GetObject impact (Signal C) on the same exposed role ARN, principal, and time window into a single 'IAM-exposure exploited to org-wide access' incident that names the misconfigured role, who assumed it, the moment it became privileged, and what data it reached.
rules.name: IAM Exposure Exploited to Org-Wide Access — Posture-to-Impact Stitch
